title: Best Nintendo Switch Lite (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Reviewed sources: TechRadar, IGN, Lens‑Rumors, SOSwitchedOn, VenomUK, PCMag.

verdict.line: Picture a traveler who wants a lightweight console for on‑the‑go play. The Switch Lite’s compact design and lower weight make it ideal for that use, and it offers the full Switch library without the dock. The catch: it cannot be connected to a TV.
